target_name: Remove Only What Is Shown To Be Superseded
source_quotes: you decide if superseded and ensured and captured and nothing dropped then remove

add_heuristics.condition: an item has no remaining producer but was not on the list
add_heuristics.action: leave it for review with that reason

add_decision_rules.name: Verify the superseder by reading
add_decision_rules.outcome: read both and confirm the old body is identical or the new item's behaviour covers it; record item, what it was, superseder and capture check in a table

add_decision_rules.name: An unimplemented specified feature is not dead code
add_decision_rules.condition: a field or function is never read but appears in the specification
add_decision_rules.outcome: treat it as a gap: wire it, or remove it together with the specification edit; leave it for review meanwhile

add_decision_rules.name: Registered by name
add_decision_rules.condition: a removed method triggered a hook or handler registered by name
add_decision_rules.outcome: confirm the successor still triggers that name, and remove the dead registrations with the method

add_decision_rules.name: Live documents change, dated history stays
add_decision_rules.outcome: rename or correct live documents and registries and leave dated checklist, status and review entries as the record

add_decision_rules.name: Delegation keeps all three tests
add_decision_rules.outcome: remove only when the item is superseded, its behaviour is captured and nothing is dropped; otherwise leave it
